# Focused Slash / Moon Strike

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Skills affected:** Focused Slash, Moon Strike
- **Mechanic tags:** skill, attack

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Focused Slash + Moon Strike canvas-support skills, driven end-to-end with baseline swords.

## Implementation (engine model)

Both are Sweep-Slash/Steep-Strike attacks resolved via `skill_resolver.py::_resolve_slash_skill` (two mutually-exclusive per-cast forms; Steep Strike fires on the Steep proc). Moon Strike also carries `extra_damage_mod_tags=['spell']` so Spell Damage inc/additional apply to its Attack Damage. Focused Slash supports (`skill_effects/focused_slash.py`): Behead emits `steep_strike_chance=1.0` (guaranteed) and removes the `area` mod tag (via `remove_mod_tags` override); Fervor (`fervor_contribution`) emits `steep_strike_additional_dmg` gated on `fervor_rating >= 5` (Fervor consumption NYI); Tranquility emits slot-local `fervor_effect_skill_inc = per × 10` (increased pool scoped to this skill's Fervor bonus, not global crit); Duel resolves via the generic parser. Moon Strike supports (`skill_effects/moon_strike.py`): Rainbow adds `steep_strike_chance` at 1%/100 Max Mana (capped); Lunar Ring only TRACKS `moon_strike_circular_chance` (DPS-neutral single-target); Lunar Eclipse (needs Mana-sealing) and Wax and Wane (Spell Burst) are DEFERRED — only the universal +20% applies.
